summary: Digital Currency X Technology Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of an extraordinary general meeting held on May 13, 2026, in Hong Kong. Shareholders approved a share capital reduction and reorganization, reducing par value from US$3.6 to US$0.0001 per share, followed by a share subdivision, cancellation of excess authorized shares, and an increase in authorized share capital from US$83,333 to US$300,000. This is a routine capital restructuring, not a special situation such as an acquisition, tender offer, or going-private transaction. No deal terms, prices, premiums, or advisors were disclosed. The filing is a non-US issuer's report of corporate housekeeping.
